name: 603 Metals
old_description: Metals delivers the same quality craftsmanship approach to all your metal fabrication needs.
about:
603 Metals operates from a shop at 724 E. Industrial Park Drive in Manchester, New Hampshire. The business was founded in January 2020 by Brian McKenna, who comes from a multi‑generational line of metalworkers tracing back to bronze workers in Ireland and a family shop in southern New Hampshire. After apprenticing under his uncle Charles Macdonald — an internationally recognized master in marine metal fabrication at CJM Custom Shop in Fort Lauderdale — McKenna managed a large production dock and gangway shop in Pompano Beach before returning to his roots to open 603 Metals.

The company provides custom metal fabrication, architectural metalwork, railings and stairs, metal art, dock and gangway solutions, and marine fabrication. Core processes include plasma, laser, and water‑jet cutting; machining; polishing; welding; and a full range of finishing services such as galvanizing, electrostatic painting, powder coating, sand blasting, patina, brushed, polished, anodized, and plated finishes. The shop also handles design, project management, and installation, working from a single facility in Manchester.

Clients include architects, designers, builders, and marine contractors. The firm has contributed to mega‑yacht projects for celebrity clientele and has seen its work published in Architectural Digest and the Boston Design Guide. It serves the architectural, marine, yachting, construction, and industrial fabrication sectors, often collaborating with engineers and draftsmen to realize complex projects.

603 Metals emphasizes craftsmanship as its guiding principle, drawing on the owner’s heritage and apprenticeship under a master fabricator. The shop positions itself as a single‑source partner that can manage a project from concept through installation, and maintains a network of specialists for capabilities outside its own scope.

name: 731 Woodworks
old_description: Trusted by 895K+ woodworkers on YouTube. Skip the costly mistakes — Matt tests the tools so you don't have to, then finds you the best price.
about:
731 Woodworks is based in Monticello, Arkansas, and operates as 731 LLC, owned by Matt and Amy Outlaw. The venture began in February 2017 when Matt, then an Arkansas State Trooper with a construction background, watched a YouTube video by Jay Bates and built a set of patio chairs that sold the next day. By May 2017 he had launched the 731 Woodworks YouTube channel, and in May 2021 he left law enforcement to run the business full time. The name references July 31, 1999, the day the couple met, and the anchor in their logo reflects a personal faith reference.

The company produces daily woodworking and tool‑focused content for a YouTube audience of over 930,000 subscribers, with more than 2,000 videos published. It monetizes through affiliate partnerships with retailers such as Amazon, Lowe’s, Home Depot, Rockler, and Acme Tools, and sells digital products — CNC and 3D‑print files, SVG/C2D plans, and step‑by‑step project bundles — delivered as instant downloads. A coaching program called Sawdust Startups serves a community of 500+ members with weekly live calls, templates, and a marketing playbook.

The primary audience is hobbyist and small‑shop woodworkers seeking tool buying guidance, project plans, and business coaching. Customers include beginners looking for free or low‑cost plans, experienced makers wanting curated tool deals, and aspiring side‑hustle builders who join the paid coaching tier. Industries served span woodworking education, digital product sales, affiliate marketing, and online community building.

The Outlaws position the brand on transparency and practical experience: Matt tests tools himself so viewers can avoid costly mistakes, and the coaching program is built on his own path from garage shop to full‑time creator. The faith‑inspired anchor logo and the origin story tied to their wedding date are cited as core differentiators.

name: 775FABRICATION
old_description: Speed UTV and Wildcat XX "Over The Axle" Wheel Bearing Greaser
about:
Based in Sparks, Nevada, 775Fabrication specializes in aftermarket components for side-by-side vehicles. The company focuses on the Arctic Cat Wildcat XX, Speed UTV, and Can-Am Maverick R platforms, offering a range of billet aluminum and chromoly steel parts.

The core of its product line consists of CNC-machined 6061-T6 billet aluminum parts, including double-shear steering rack brackets, steering stops, rack and pinion assemblies, and various mounting brackets. The shop also produces 4130 chromoly weld bungs and supplies replacement wheel bearings, bearing greasers, and installation tools. All items are designed as direct bolt-on upgrades that include necessary hardware.

Customers are primarily powersports enthusiasts and off-road racers who own Wildcat XX, Speed UTV, or Maverick R machines. The catalog also includes skid plates, light mounts, tow points, and differential bushings tailored to those models.

The company emphasizes precision machining for durability and direct-fit installation to reduce stress on factory mounting points, positioning its parts as upgrades over OEM components.

name: 8MSolar
about:
8MSolar is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. The company was founded by Ali Buttar and Usman Noor, who relocated from Ohio after years at a solar firm there. Seeking to combine engineering and construction under one roof and avoid investor-driven delays, they established 8MSolar in Raleigh, drawn by the region’s sunny climate and growing solar market.

The firm provides turnkey solar photovoltaic and battery storage installations for residential and commercial customers. Its in-house team includes licensed professional electrical engineers (PE) operating as a Chapter 87 Engineering Firm, and the company holds Unlimited General Contractors (license #82456) and Unlimited Electrical Contractors licenses. 8MSolar manages design, permitting, utility interconnection, and installation using Pegasus Solar racking systems, and remains hardware-agnostic across panel, inverter, and battery brands.

Clients span homeowners, corporations, non-profits, government agencies, and agricultural operations. Notable commercial and government references include Caterpillar, Honda of the Carolinas, the City of Durham, the Town of Apex, and City of Raleigh Fire Departments, as well as poultry farms and self-storage facilities.

The founders’ original vision was to eliminate the fragmentation between engineering and construction that slowed project delivery. 8MSolar differentiates itself through single-source accountability, lifetime workmanship and roof-penetration warranties, and a certification portfolio that includes NABCEP, Tesla PowerWall, Enphase, SolarEdge, Generac, and multiple module-manufacturer partner programs.

name: A & M Plastics Inc
old_description: A&M Plastics was founded on a dream, hard work, and a shared passion for manufacturing.
about:
A&M Plastics operates from South Houston, Texas, where Arthur and Kathy Mason founded the company in 1988. The couple met while working in the plastics industry in the Midwest, then moved to Texas to build their own business. They started with two injection molding machines that Arthur salvaged from a field and restored himself, laying the groundwork for what remains a family-owned operation today.

The shop runs ten injection molding presses and two extrusion lines, supported by machining, assembly, sonic welding, hot stamping, and other secondary operations. In-house mold development, engineering support, and prototyping feed into production, while warehouse space and drop-shipping services allow customers to consolidate supply-chain steps. Over more than 35 years the company has brought hundreds of products to market and shipped millions of parts.

Customers span automotive, medical, oil and gas, construction, and consumer-products sectors. Named accounts include Igloo, Parker Hannifin, Emerson, Safety Maker, and projects supporting NASA; a testimonial from Liquid Health Labs highlights quick setup and reliable delivery.

The founders frame their differentiation around the responsiveness and accountability that a family-owned structure enables, emphasizing a lean operational approach, single-source manufacturing from concept through fulfillment, and a commitment to long-term partnership over transactional relationships.

The product mix targets professional technicians and resellers needing ready-to-ship inventory for routine vehicle service.

The company emphasizes availability of multiple brake cleaner formulations to meet varying regulatory requirements across states, alongside a high-volume synthetic motor oil offering for heavy-use applications.

name: AA Auto Parts
old_description: that specializes in southern hospitality and used/rebuilt foreign auto parts, especially Toyota and Honda.
about:
AA Auto Parts operates from North Little Rock, Arkansas, where it has served as a salvage yard for late-model foreign vehicles since 1976. The business began with a focus on Toyota and Honda parts, building a reputation for southern hospitality and straightforward service.

The company stocks used, rebuilt, and new aftermarket components, adding new arrivals daily to an online inventory that customers can search by part number or vehicle. It offers a standard 90-day replacement warranty, with optional 6- and 12-month coverage, and provides same-day shipping on most common parts along with free local delivery. AA Auto Parts holds membership in the Automotive Recyclers Association and the Arkansas Automotive Dismantlers & Recyclers Association and carries the Locator Seal of Approval.

Customers range from individual vehicle owners and restoration enthusiasts to repair shops across the United States seeking cost-effective replacements for foreign makes. The company emphasizes its ability to source hard-to-find electrical components and parts for customized setups, positioning itself as a single source for keeping older imports on the road.

Founded on the principle that salvaging quality used parts is both economically and environmentally sound, AA Auto Parts differentiates itself through unflinching customer service, honest mileage disclosure, and a commitment to making the parts-finding process as simple as possible.
